question: which city succeeded in hosting India's first-ever night street race in August 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chennai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai** successfully hosted India’s **first-ever night street race** in **August 2023**.
 
• The event was part of the **Indian Racing League (IRL)**, which aims to promote motorsports in India.
 
• The race took place on the **Madras International Circuit**, one of the oldest and most prominent racing tracks in India.
 
• This marked a significant milestone for motorsport enthusiasts in India, showcasing **global standards of racing infrastructure** and organization.
 
• The event featured participation from **top-tier drivers** and included advanced technologies in track lighting and safety measures.
 
• Chennai has long been considered the **hub of motorsports** in India, with a strong legacy of hosting motorsport events.
 
• The success of the night street race reflects the city’s capability to organize **international-standard events** and boosts tourism and global recognition.
 
• Night races are significant as they **enhance the visual appeal** for spectators, allowing better attendance and television viewership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bengaluru**__

 __
 
• **Bengaluru** is often referred to as the **Silicon Valley of India** because of its role as the leading information technology hub.
 
• The city is known for its **pleasant weather** and vibrant startup ecosystem.
 
• Bengaluru hosts various motorsport events, but it did not host India’s first-ever night street race.
 
 
 
• **Kolkata**__
 __
 
• **Kolkata** is renowned for its **colonial architecture**, rich culture, and history.
 
• The city is not traditionally associated with motorsports but is known for hosting other sporting events such as **football and cricket tournaments.**
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**__
 
 
• **Mumbai** is India’s **financial capital** and home to several corporate headquarters and entertainment hubs.
 
• While Mumbai has hosted car rallies and other automotive events, it did not host the night street race in 2023.
